title: Keynote Presentation: Joining the Dots: Is the Time Right for an Integrated LFP Battery Supply Chain in Africa?
gist: Member-only video page for Mervyn Stevens (Worley) keynote at Giga Africa 2026 asking whether an integrated LFP battery supply chain in Africa is viable; the text holds only the title and a session agenda (storage pipeline, copper, graphite and anodes outside China, lithium), with no substantive content from the talk itself.

insights.claim: Worley's Vice President for Battery Mineral & Materials, Mervyn Stevens, gave a keynote at Giga Africa 2026 framing the question of whether the time is right for an integrated LFP battery supply chain in Africa.
insights.speaker: Mervyn Stevens
insights.so_what: Signals industry interest in building LFP battery value chains in Africa; the talk's content is paywalled so no conclusion is available.

insights.claim: The Giga Africa 2026 programme includes a keynote on mapping Africa's battery storage pipeline and future energy storage demand.
insights.speaker: Mervyn Stevens
insights.so_what: Indicates battery energy storage is treated as a core demand pillar for African battery supply chains.
insights.locator: Keynote Presentation: Visualising Africa's Battery Storage Pipeline

insights.claim: The Giga Africa 2026 programme includes a panel on graphite and anodes outside China, focused on what it actually takes to get projects built.
insights.speaker: Mervyn Stevens
insights.so_what: Shows non-China anode supply is a live build-out theme alongside African LFP ambitions.

insights.claim: The Giga Africa 2026 programme includes a lithium panel on Africa's growing lithium resources, project pipeline and increasing role in global battery supply chains, including investment opportunities across the value chain.
insights.speaker: Mervyn Stevens
insights.so_what: Frames Africa as a growing lithium supply and investment destination, worth watching for project announcements.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Powering the Battery Boom

source_meta.author: Mervyn Stevens , Vice President - Battery Mineral & Materials , Worley
